description: Check whether text begins with a prefix. Missing or null inputs use empty text.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to inspect. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: prefix
inputs.description: Text that the value must begin with. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: True when the value begins with the prefix.

description: Check whether text ends with a suffix. Missing or null inputs use empty text.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to inspect. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: suffix
inputs.description: Text that the value must end with. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: True when the value ends with the suffix.

description: Replace every literal occurrence of target text with replacement text. The target is treated as plain text, not a regular expression.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to modify. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Literal text to find. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: replacement
inputs.description: Literal text to insert for every target occurrence. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The value after every literal target occurrence is replaced.

description: Replace every regular-expression match in text. Missing or null inputs use empty text.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to modify. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: Regular expression to find. Missing or null input uses an empty pattern.

inputs.name: replacement
inputs.description: Text inserted for each regular-expression match. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The value after every regular-expression match is replaced.

description: Encode text as Base64 using its UTF-8 bytes. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to encode using UTF-8 bytes. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: encoded
outputs.description: Base64 text produced from the input's UTF-8 bytes.

description: Encode text for a URL using UTF-8. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to encode using UTF-8. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: encoded
outputs.description: URL-encoded text produced from the input using UTF-8.

description: Join a list of strings with a separator. Missing or null lists are empty, and a missing or null separator uses a comma.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: Strings to join in order. Missing or null input uses an empty list.

inputs.name: separator
inputs.description: Text placed between items. Missing or null input uses a comma.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The list items joined in order with the separator.
